ImageDescription.value: The trailhead of the Wicklow Way in Marlay Park, County Dublin, Ireland. The Wicklow Way is a 132km long-distance National Waymarked Trail that runs from Marlay Park across County Wicklow and ends at Clonegal in County Carlow. The trailhead is denoted by a map board (not shown) and a low stone wall with a stile through which walkers pass to make their first step on the Wicklow Way. The wall was erected in 2006 as part of a series of works to mark the 25th anniversary of the opening of the Way.
